entries.1a2e8abfd4926d35: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,117,440 million, up 5.3% from ¥1,061,626 million in the previous fiscal year (the fiscal year ended March 2025). By product group in store sales, pharmaceuticals were ¥387,707 million, cosmetics ¥381,282 million, daily necessities ¥194,103 million and food ¥97,990 million. In the Matsumoto Kiyoshi Group business, sales were strong, mainly in cosmetics, as the group captured increased foot traffic in urban areas, downtown districts and commercial facilities, as well as demand from foreign visitors to Japan.

entries.40c7323891c5e1f6: Centered on the 'Matsumotokiyoshi' banner, this business operates chains of drugstores and insurance-dispensing pharmacies, and also opens and runs insurance-dispensing pharmacies, develops franchise operations and supplies products to franchisees. The core company is Matsumotokiyoshi Co., Ltd., and it includes regional sales companies (East Japan, Koshinetsu, Chugoku-Shikoku and Kyushu) and Papasumo Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥711,030 million (up 6.6% year on year), the largest of the four reportable segments. The company explains that cosmetics led strong sales, as it captured increased foot traffic in urban areas, downtown districts and commercial facilities, and demand from inbound foreign tourists. As of March 31, 2026, the number of domestic stores was 1,970 (of which 481 were dispensing pharmacies), and 313 stores were members of the 'Dispensing Support Program' that supports pharmacy management. Overseas stores total 100: 37 in Thailand, 23 in Taiwan, 20 in Vietnam, 18 in Hong Kong, 1 in Guam and 1 in Malaysia. Leveraging 169,550,000 customer touchpoints, it is advancing efforts to combine stores with its app and online store.

entries.4a7494d9de6ad892: This business procures and sells products handled by group companies, manages and oversees group companies, and undertakes indirect operations on consignment. It also includes planning and development of private-brand products, asset management and operation, store construction and maintenance, temp staffing and placement services, and sales agency for life and non-life insurance. The core company is MCC Management Co., Ltd., and the holding company itself (headquartered in Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo) also belongs to this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,534 million (down 4.2% year on year), but revenue including internal revenue from group companies was ¥683,585 million. The company explains that it also supplies products externally, undertakes construction work and advertising, and that the scope of its operations is expanding. It has the smallest external-customer revenue of the reportable segments, and most of its revenue comes from transactions within the group.

entries.5dd34cbb1bf44f0e: This business comprises And Company Co., Ltd., an intermediate holding company, and its subsidiary Shinseido Pharmacy Co., Ltd., which operates pharmacies and drugstores mainly in northern Kyushu. It operates chains of drugstores and insurance-dispensing pharmacies, and opens and runs insurance-dispensing pharmacies. And Company was established in August 2025, and Shinseido Pharmacy became a subsidiary on October 1, 2025, so this business was newly added as a reportable segment from the third quarter. The prior-year segment information contains no amounts for this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,947 million, and the number of domestic stores as of March 31, 2026 was 112 (of which 93 were dispensing pharmacies). The company explains that it is studying and promoting measures such as product procurement and system integration, combining its strengths with the know-how and resources of the group, aiming to expand share and improve convenience in priority areas.

entries.8dd15f96f58fecb7: Centered on the 'Cocokara Fine' banner, this business operates chains of drugstores and insurance-dispensing pharmacies, and also opens and runs insurance-dispensing pharmacies, operates care facilities, provides home-visit care, rents and sells nursing care products, and supplies products such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and household goods. The core company is Cocokara Fine Healthcare Co., Ltd., and it also includes Iwasaki Kokendo Co., Ltd. (absorbed by merger into Cocokara Fine Healthcare effective April 1, 2026), among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥389,926 million (down 0.3% year on year). In this period, it pursued scrap-and-build measures aimed at improving profitability through the reallocation of human capital and optimization of management resources. It is also working to develop loyal customers through promotions using its app. As of March 31, 2026, the number of domestic stores was 1,536 (of which 538 were dispensing pharmacies).

entries.e95a87de542241e3: Toward the group management targets for the fiscal year ended March 2031, it is advancing 3 priority strategies under the idea of "co-creating and sharing value." The "differentiation strategy" consists of improving convenience through collaboration between drugstores and the dispensing pharmacy business, and expanding business areas, including BtoB. The "investment strategy" consists of investment in digital technology and systems, stronger store openings in priority areas centered on major metropolitan areas, scale expansion through M&A, adding dispensing pharmacies to stores, and expansion of overseas business centered on ASEAN. "Social contribution and returns" consists of practicing sustainable management. Its targets include becoming the Asia No.1 drugstore and establishing a leading position in the beauty and health field.
